Trans (mtl):

Transforming heroines swallowed whole and absorbed!!

This is the digital version of an illustration book (16 pages total: 12 pages of main content + 4 other pages) originally released at C100.
It tells the story of a trio of transforming heroines who are attacked and swallowed whole by a monstrous female enemy.
Features tailvore and assimilation/absorption via mucus; the story ends just as the last remaining heroine prepares to face the threat.
There are no depictions of sexual intercourse or the interior of the body.
